root_cause: Lengths obtained from sqlite3_value_bytes() (an int, bounded in principle only by the compile-time SQLITE_MAX_LENGTH) are stored and summed using 32-bit 'int' arithmetic (nBlob = nLocale + 1 + nText) and then passed to the 32-bit-size-parameter sqlite3_malloc(), instead of using a 64-bit type and sqlite3_malloc64() throughout the computation and allocation.
